raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "transfer"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "4.500 euro"
  role source "the user's account at ING"
  role destination "the user's son's account at Banca Transilvania"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "pay"
  role subject "the user's son"
  role object "the deposit at the rental in Vienna"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "must declare to ANAF as a donation"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "the amount"
    polarity affirmed
  end
